description: This file defines the OA_Version_Controller class, which manages versioning information for the application, including schema versions, application versions, component group versions, and related database operations.

classes.name: OA_Version_Controller
classes.description: A class responsible for managing version information and database operations related to application, schema, and component versions within the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a database handle and sets the version table name.

methods.name: tableAppVarsExists
methods.description: Checks if the application variable table exists in the list of existing tables.

methods.name: getSchemaVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version for a given schema.

methods.name: putSchemaVersion
methods.description: Updates or inserts the schema version for a given schema.

methods.name: _insertSchemaVersion
methods.description: Inserts a new schema version record into the database.

methods.name: _updateSchemaVersion
methods.description: Updates an existing schema version record in the database.

methods.name: getApplicationVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the application version for a specified product.

methods.name: _insertApplicationVersion
methods.description: Inserts a new application version record.

methods.name: _updateApplicationVersion
methods.description: Updates an existing application version record.

methods.name: putApplicationVersion
methods.description: Sets the application version, updating or inserting as needed.

methods.name: getComponentGroupVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a specified component group.

methods.name: putComponentGroupVersion
methods.description: Updates or inserts the version of a component group.

methods.name: _insertComponentGroupVersion
methods.description: Inserts a new component group version record.

methods.name: _updateComponentGroupVersion
methods.description: Updates an existing component group version record.

methods.name: _getQueryUpdate
methods.description: Constructs an SQL UPDATE query for a given name and value.

methods.name: _getQueryInsert
methods.description: Constructs an SQL INSERT query for a given name and value.

methods.name: _getQuerySelect
methods.description: Constructs an SQL SELECT query for a given name.

methods.name: _runQuery
methods.description: Executes a query expected to return a single value.

methods.name: _execQuery
methods.description: Executes a query that modifies the database.

methods.name: removeVariable
methods.description: Removes a variable from the version table.

methods.name: removeVersion
methods.description: Removes a version variable with a '_version' suffix.

methods.name: removeMaxVersion
methods.description: Removes the 'max' version variable.

methods.name: removeOpenadsVersion
methods.description: Removes the 'oa' version variable.
